rules.rule: Marketing information must be sufficient for and likely to be understood by the average member of the target group (or the group likely to receive it).
rules.applicability: Applies to client-facing information/marketing communications directed to a specific group or likely to be received by a specific group.
rules.source_quote: the information is sufficient for, and presented in a way that is likely to be understood by, the average member of the group to whom it is directed, or by whom it is likely to be received,

rules.rule: Information about financial instruments and proposed investment strategies must state whether the financial instrument is intended for retail clients or professional clients, taking account of the identified target market.
rules.applicability: Applies when a marketing communication provides information on a financial instrument; the stated intended client type should reflect the identified target market.
rules.source_quote: and whether the financial instrument is intended for retail or professional clients, taking account of the identified target market

rules.rule: Any comparison in a marketing communication must be meaningful and presented in a fair and balanced way.
rules.applicability: Applies when the marketing communication includes a comparison (e.g., versus another product, benchmark, provider, or prior period).
rules.source_quote: the comparison is meaningful and presented in a fair and balanced way;

rules.rule: When making a comparison, include the key facts and assumptions used to make the comparison.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications that include a comparison (e.g., comparing products, providers, performance, costs, or features).
rules.source_quote: the key facts and assumptions used to make the comparison are included.

rules.rule: When a marketing communication includes a comparison, it must specify the sources of the information used for the comparison.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications that make comparisons (e.g., product/service performance, costs, features) using information that has identifiable sources.
rules.source_quote: the sources of the information used for the comparison are specified;

rules.rule: Information must be consistently presented in the same language throughout all forms of information and marketing materials provided to each client.
rules.applicability: Applies to information and marketing materials provided to each client, unless the client has accepted to receive information in more than one language.
rules.source_quote: the information is consistently presented in the same language throughout all forms of information and marketing materials that are provided to each client, unless the client has accepted to receive information in more than one language

rules.rule: If returns are indicated using figures denominated in a currency other than the retail client’s (or potential retail client’s) Member State currency, the communication must clearly state the currency and include a warning that the return may increase or decrease due to currency fluctuations.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications to retail clients or potential retail clients where an indication of return relies on figures denominated in a currency other than that of the Member State in which the client is resident.
rules.source_quote: the currency is clearly stated, together with a warning that the return may increase or decrease as a result of currency fluctuations;

rules.rule: Marketing communications must be fair, clear and not misleading.
rules.applicability: Applies to all marketing communications (and other information) addressed by an investment firm to clients or potential clients.
rules.source_quote: All information, including marketing communications, addressed by the investment firm to clients or potential clients shall be fair, clear and not misleading.

rules.rule: Include the name of the investment firm in the information/marketing communication.
rules.applicability: Applies where the communication constitutes 'information' within the meaning of Article 44(2)(a).
rules.source_quote: the information includes the name of the investment firm,

rules.rule: Any forward-looking information (e.g., forecasts or projected performance) must be based on reasonable assumptions supported by objective data.
rules.applicability: Applies when a marketing communication includes forward-looking information that relies on assumptions (e.g., projections/forecasts).
rules.source_quote: the information is based on reasonable assumptions supported by objective data;

rules.rule: When presenting information based on performance scenarios, include scenarios for different market conditions covering both negative and positive outcomes.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications where the information presented is based on performance scenarios.
rules.source_quote: performance scenarios in different market conditions (both negative and positive scenarios)

rules.rule: Include a prominent warning that forecasts are not a reliable indicator of future performance.
rules.applicability: Applies when the marketing communication includes forecasts (i.e., statements about expected/future performance).
rules.source_quote: contains a prominent warning that such forecasts are not a reliable indicator of future performance.

rules.rule: If performance is indicated on a gross basis, the communication must disclose the effect of commissions, fees, or other charges.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications/client-facing information that indicates performance based on gross performance.
rules.source_quote: where the indication is based on gross performance, the effect of commissions, fees or other charges are disclosed.

rules.rule: Marketing information must be accurate.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing/client-facing information about investment services or financial instruments.
rules.source_quote: the information is accurate

rules.rule: Ensure that information in a marketing communication is consistent with information the firm provides to clients when providing investment and ancillary services.
rules.applicability: Applies to investment firms for any marketing communication relating to investment and ancillary services; requires consistency with other client information provided by the firm.
rules.source_quote: information contained in a marketing communication is consistent with any information the firm provides to clients

rules.rule: Marketing communications must be clearly identifiable as marketing communications.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications addressed by an investment firm to clients or potential clients.
rules.source_quote: Marketing communications shall be clearly identifiable as such.

rules.rule: Marketing information must not disguise, diminish, or obscure important items, statements, or warnings.
rules.applicability: Applies to information provided in marketing communications/client-facing information content.
rules.source_quote: the information does not disguise, diminish or obscure important items, statements or warnings,

rules.rule: If a marketing communication contains an offer or invitation, it must include the relevant information required by the first subparagraph (i.e., the Article 47-50 information), unless the communication requires the potential client to refer to other document(s) that contain that information.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications that contain an offer or invitation (including an invitation to respond by making an offer to enter into an agreement relating to a financial instrument, investment service or ancillary service). Exception: does not apply where, to respond, the potential client must refer to another document or documents that contain the required information.
rules.source_quote: However, the first subparagraph shall not apply if, in order to respond to an offer or invitation contained in the marketing communication, the potential client must refer to another document or documents, which, alone or in combination, contain that information.

rules.rule: Any indication of past performance must not be the most prominent feature of the marketing communication.
rules.applicability: Applies when the marketing communication includes an indication of past performance.
rules.source_quote: that indication is not the most prominent feature of the communication;

rules.rule: State clearly the reference period and the source of information for any performance information presented.
rules.applicability: Applies when the marketing communication includes performance information (e.g., past performance figures).
rules.source_quote: the reference period and the source of information is clearly stated;

rules.rule: When past-performance figures are included, the communication must include a prominent warning that the figures refer to the past and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications/information that contains past-performance figures.
rules.source_quote: contains a prominent warning that the figures refer to the past and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results

rules.rule: When including performance information, it must cover the preceding 5 years, or (if shorter) the whole period the instrument has been offered / index established / service provided; any longer period may be used at the firm’s discretion, but performance information must in every case be based on complete 12‑month periods.
rules.applicability: Applies to client-facing information that includes performance information for a financial instrument, financial index, or investment service. If the relevant period is less than 5 years, cover the whole available period; the firm may choose a longer period. Performance figures must be presented in complete 12-month periods.
rules.source_quote: include appropriate performance information which covers the preceding 5 years, or the whole period for which the financial instrument has been offered, the financial index has been established, or the investment service has been provided where less than five years, or such longer period as the firm may decide, and in every case that performance information is based on complete 12-month periods

rules.rule: Do not use the name of any competent authority in a way that indicates or suggests that the authority endorses or approves the investment firm’s products or services.
rules.applicability: Applies to any client-facing information/marketing text that mentions a competent authority (e.g., regulator).
rules.source_quote: shall not use the name of any competent authority in such a way that would indicate or suggest endorsement or approval

rules.rule: When the marketing text references potential benefits of an investment service or financial instrument, it must also give a fair and prominent indication of any relevant risks.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing/client-facing information that references any potential benefits of an investment service or financial instrument.
rules.source_quote: gives a fair and prominent indication of any relevant risks when referencing any potential benefits

rules.rule: Information about financial instruments and proposed investment strategies must include appropriate guidance on and warnings of the risks associated with investing in those instruments or using those strategies.
rules.applicability: Applies when a marketing communication provides information on financial instruments and/or proposed investment strategies.
rules.source_quote: must include appropriate guidance on and warnings of the risks associated with investments in those instruments or in respect of particular investment strategies

rules.rule: Performance-scenario information must reflect the nature and risks of the specific types of instruments included in the analysis.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications where the information presented is based on performance scenarios for specific instrument types.
rules.source_quote: reflects the nature and risks of the specific types of instruments included in the analysis

rules.rule: If simulated past performance is presented, it must be based on the actual past performance of one or more financial instruments or financial indices that are the same as, substantially the same as, or underlie the financial instrument being marketed.
rules.applicability: Applies when a marketing communication includes simulated past performance for a financial instrument.
rules.source_quote: the simulated past performance is based on the actual past performance of one or more financial instruments or financial indices which are the same as, or substantially the same as, or underlie, the financial instrument concerned;

rules.rule: Do not base information on, or refer to, simulated past performance.
rules.applicability: Applies to information provided in the context of Article 44(6)(a).
rules.source_quote: the information is not based on or refer to simulated past performance;

rules.rule: If the marketing information includes or refers to simulated past performance, it must relate to a financial instrument or a financial index.
rules.applicability: Applies where the information (including marketing communications) includes or refers to simulated past performance.
rules.source_quote: Where the information includes or refers to simulated past performance, investment firms shall ensure that the information relates to a financial instrument or a financial index

rules.rule: If simulated past performance figures are presented, the communication must include a prominent warning that (i) the figures refer to simulated past performance and (ii) past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.
rules.applicability: Applies to marketing communications/information that contains simulated past performance figures.
rules.source_quote: contains a prominent warning that the figures refer to simulated past performance and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

rules.rule: If the marketing text refers to a particular tax treatment, it must state that the tax treatment depends on each client’s individual circumstances and may change in the future.
rules.applicability: Applies to any marketing communication/information that refers to a particular tax treatment.
rules.source_quote: it shall prominently state that the tax treatment depends on the individual circumstances of each client and may be subject to change in the future.

rules.rule: Marketing information must be up-to-date and relevant to the means of communication used.
rules.applicability: Applies to information included in marketing communications/client-facing information.
rules.source_quote: the information is up-to-date and relevant to the means of communication used.
